previous_statement: Assume U is a nonempty proper subset of C and fix exactly one reset state v_U:M_{|U|}->A_U with recorded epsilon_U=W.L*epsilon and the two required bounds. Choose j in C minus U and put R=U union {j}, epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and t_2:=W.K2*epsilon. Since U and j lie in the hypothesized single equivalence class, and nodes 1.1.2-1.1.3 supply epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, the target corner A_R, all scale inequalities, and the required W coefficient conditions, lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope applies to this exact prior state v_U and furnishes the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum in A_R with total defect at most C_s2^0*t_2.
new_statement: Assume U is a nonempty proper subset of C and fix exactly one current reset state on U whose supplied map v_U:M_{|U|}->A_U is tagged as an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_U-isomorphism, with recorded epsilon_U:=W.L*epsilon, d_U <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U, and ||v_U(I_{M_{|U|}})-u_{A_U}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_U. Choose j in C minus U and put R:=U union {j}, epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and t_2:=W.K2*epsilon. Form a supplied MAIN partition state for the same A,w by retaining the root state geometry and replacing its current-subset field by U and its reset-state reference by this exact state and exact map v_U. Since U and j lie in the hypothesized single equivalence class, nodes 1.1.2-1.1.3 supply epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, the target corner A_R, all scale inequalities, and the required W coefficient conditions; hence lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope applies to this matching partition state and exact prior isomorphism v_U and furnishes the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum in A_R with total defect at most C_s2^0*t_2.
